findings.text: The new asserts on `self.body`, `self.header` and `self.header.row` turn a missing section into an AssertionError, and `python -O` strips them. A header-only table such as `| a |\n|---|` yields no tbody, so `self.body` stays None. It crashes either way, and the change does not make it render as a table with no rows. The fix is to guard with `if self.body is not None` instead of asserting.
